<h2 id="一首先对比xml反序列化">一、首先对比Xml反序列化</h2>
<h3 id="1-性能对比">1. 性能对比</h3>
<h4 id="11-性能测试结果如下">1.1 性能测试结果如下</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>Deserialize是反序列化结果</li>
<li>GetResult是基于反射的对象构建方法,比反序列化快31%</li>
<li>GetResult2是定制对象构建组件,避免了反射,比GetResult快一点</li>
<li>Custom继承重写EntityParser,避免字典查找,比GetResult2更快一点</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>

<h3 id="12-相关代码如下">1.2 相关代码如下</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">    private static readonly XmlSerializer _serializer = new(typeof(User));
    private static readonly FirstReader&lt;User&gt; _parser = HandXml.Default.Entity&lt;User&gt;()
        .WithItem&lt;int&gt;(nameof(User.Id))
        .WithItem(nameof(User.Name))
        .WithItem&lt;int&gt;(nameof(User.Age))
        .First();
    private static readonly FirstReader&lt;User&gt; _parser2 = HandXml.Default.Entity(UserBuilder.Creater)
        .WithItem&lt;int&gt;(nameof(User.Id))
        .WithItem(nameof(User.Name))
        .WithItem&lt;int&gt;(nameof(User.Age))
        .First();
    private static readonly UserParser _customParser = new(HandXml.Default);

    [Benchmark(Baseline = true)]
    public User? Deserialize()
    {
        using var stringReader = new StringReader(text);
        return (User?)_serializer.Deserialize(stringReader);
    }
    [Benchmark]
    public User GetResult()
    {
        return _parser.Get(text);
    }
    [Benchmark]
    public User GetResult2()
    {
        return _parser2.Get(text);
    }
    [Benchmark]
    public User Custom()
    {
        return _customParser.Get(text);
    }
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">[Serializable]
public class User
{
    public int Id { get; set; }
    public string Name { get; set; }
    public int Age { get; set; }
}
/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 建造者模式
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
public class UserBuilder2
    : IMemberBuilder&lt;User&gt;
{
    private readonly User _original = new();
    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 原始对象
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    public User Original
        =&gt; _original;
    /// &lt;inheritdoc /&gt;
    public User Build()
        =&gt; _original;
    /// &lt;inheritdoc /&gt;
    public void Save&lt;TMember&gt;(string name, TMember value)
    {
        switch (name)
        {
            case nameof(User.Id):
                if (value is int idValue)
                    _original.Id = idValue;
                break;
            case nameof(User.Name):
                if (value is string nameValue)
                    _original.Name = nameValue;
                break;
            case nameof(User.Age):
                if (value is int ageValue)
                    _original.Age = ageValue;
                break;
            default:
                break;
        }
    }
    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 工厂模式
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    public static readonly ICreator&lt;UserBuilder2&gt; Creater = new DefaultCreater&lt;UserBuilder2&gt;();
}
public class UserParser(HandXml xml)
    : EntityParser&lt;User&gt;(xml, UserBuilder2.Creater, null, true)
{
    #region 配置
    private readonly IXmlParser&lt;int&gt; _id = xml.Content&lt;int&gt;();
    private readonly ContentReader _name = xml.Content();
    private readonly IXmlParser&lt;int&gt; _age = xml.Content&lt;int&gt;();
    #endregion
    /// &lt;inheritdoc /&gt;
    public override void ReadAttributes(IMemberStore entity, XmlReader reader) { }
    /// &lt;inheritdoc /&gt;
    public override void ReadItem(IMemberBuilder&lt;User&gt; entity, XmlReader reader, string name)
    {
        if (entity is UserBuilder2 builder)
            ReadItem(builder.Original, reader, name);
        else
            base.ReadItem(entity, reader, name);
    }
    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 使用自定义构造器
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="entity"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="reader"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="name"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;
    public void ReadItem(User entity, XmlReader reader, string name)
    {        
        switch (name)
        {
            case nameof(User.Id):
                if (_id.TryParser(reader, out var idResult))
                    entity.Id = idResult;
                break;
            case nameof(User.Name):
                if (_name.TryParser(reader, out var nameResult))
                    entity.Name = nameResult;
                break;
            case nameof(User.Age):
                if (_age.TryParser(reader, out var ageResult))
                    entity.Age = ageResult;
                break;
        }
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="13-性能分析">1.3 性能分析</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>ParseXml开箱即用性能就比XmlSerializer好不少</li>
<li>通过定制对象构建组件或扩展重写能进一步提高性能</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="2-通用性对比">2. 通用性对比</h3>
<h4 id="21-xmlserializer通过attribute标记映射">2.1 XmlSerializer通过Attribute标记映射</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>通过XmlRoot、XmlAttribute和XmlElement来映射属性</li>
<li>一个类只能支持一种格式的xml文件</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">[XmlRoot("Root")]
public class Person
{
    [XmlAttribute("PersonId")]
    public int Id { get; set; }
    [XmlElement("PersonName")]
    public string Name { get; set; }

    private static readonly XmlSerializer _serializer = new(typeof(Person));

    [Fact]
    public void Deserialize()
    {
        var text = @"&lt;?xml version=""1.0"" encoding=""utf-8""?&gt;
            &lt;Root PersonId=""1""&gt;
    	        &lt;PersonName&gt;张三&lt;/PersonName&gt;
            &lt;/Root&gt;";
        using var stringReader = new StringReader(text);
        Person? person = _serializer.Deserialize(stringReader) as Person;
        Assert.NotNull(person);
        Assert.Equal(1, person.Id);
        Assert.Equal("张三", person.Name);
    }
    [Fact]
    public void Throw()
    {
        var text = @"&lt;?xml version=""1.0"" encoding=""utf-8""?&gt;
            &lt;Person&gt;
                &lt;Id&gt;1&lt;/Id&gt;
    	        &lt;Name&gt;张三&lt;/Name&gt;
            &lt;/Person&gt;";
        using var stringReader = new StringReader(text);
        Assert.ThrowsAny&lt;InvalidOperationException&gt;(() =&gt; _serializer.Deserialize(stringReader));
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="22-parsexml通过fluent-api配置">2.2 ParseXml通过Fluent API配置</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>WithItem配置节点</li>
<li>WithAttribute配置属性</li>
<li>Entity支持可选参数配置当前标签映射</li>
<li>映射的成员可以是属性也可以是字段和构造函数的参数</li>
<li>配置的解析Xml对象可以定义为静态或注入IOC容器,该对象解析Xml不产生状态支持多线程同时调用(线程安全)</li>
<li>同一个类可以配置多个解析对象用来把不同格式的Xml转化为相同类型的对象</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">public record User(int Id, string Name);
.
    [Fact]
    public void WithNode()
    {
        var id = 123;
        var name = "Jxj";
        var text = @$"&lt;?xml version=""1.0"" encoding=""utf-8""?&gt;
&lt;User&gt;
	&lt;Id&gt;{id}&lt;/Id&gt;
	&lt;Name&gt;{name}&lt;/Name&gt;
&lt;/User&gt;";

        var userParser = HandXml.Default.Entity&lt;User&gt;()
            .WithItem&lt;int&gt;(nameof(User.Id))
            .WithItem(nameof(User.Name))
            .First();
        User result = userParser.Get(text);
        Assert.NotNull(result);
        Assert.Equal(id, result.Id);
        Assert.Equal(name, result.Name);
    }
    [Fact]
    public void WithAttribute()
    {
        var id = 123;
        var name = "Jxj";
        var text = @$"&lt;?xml version=""1.0"" encoding=""utf-8""?&gt;
            &lt;User Id=""{id}"" Name=""{name}"" /&gt;";

        var userParser = HandXml.Default.Entity&lt;User&gt;()
            .WithAttribute&lt;int&gt;(nameof(User.Id))
            .WithAttribute(nameof(User.Name))
            .First("User");
        User result = userParser.Get(text);
        Assert.NotNull(result);
        Assert.Equal(id, result.Id);
        Assert.Equal(name, result.Name);
    }
    [Fact]
    public void Content()
    {
        var id = 123;
        var name = "Jxj";
        var text = @$"&lt;?xml version=""1.0"" encoding=""utf-8""?&gt;
            &lt;User Id=""{id}""&gt;{name}&lt;/User&gt;";

        var userParser = HandXml.Default.Entity&lt;User&gt;(nameof(User.Name))
            .WithAttribute&lt;int&gt;(nameof(User.Id))
            .First("User");
        User result = userParser.Get(text);
        Assert.NotNull(result);
        Assert.Equal(id, result.Id);
        Assert.Equal(name, result.Name);
    }
</code></pre>
<h3 id="23-通用性分析">2.3 通用性分析</h3>
<p>| 特性        | XmlSerializer     | ParseXml                       |<br>
|:----------- |: ---------------- |:------------------------------ |<br>
| 同类Xml格式 | 只支持一种格式    | 支持多种                       |<br>
| 映射对象    | 只映射属性        | 映射属性、字段和构造函数参数   |<br>
| 映射Xml结构 | 支持属性和子节点  | 支持属性、子节点和当前节点     |<br>
| 结果类型    | object需要转化    | 当前类型,直接使用              |</p>
<h2 id="二parsexml主要功能">二、ParseXml主要功能</h2>
<h3 id="1-读取单个节点">1. 读取单个节点</h3>
<h4 id="11-读取原始值">1.1 读取原始值</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>使用First方法读取单个节点原始值</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var summaryReader = HandXml.Default.First("summary");
string summary = summaryReader.Get(xmlReader);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="12-读取强类型值">1.2 读取强类型值</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>使用First泛型方法读取单个节点强类型值</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var idParser = HandXml.Default.First&lt;int&gt;("Id");
int id = idParser.Get(xmlReader);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-读取单个属性">2. 读取单个属性</h3>
<h4 id="21-读取原始值">2.1 读取原始值</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>使用Attribute方法读取属性原始值</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var text = @"&lt;member name = ""F:GenerateConvertTests.Supports.ColumnType.Identity""&gt;
    &lt;summary&gt;
    自增列
    &lt;/summary&gt;
&lt;/member&gt;";
using var stringReader = new StringReader(text);
using var xmlReader = XmlReader.Create(stringReader);
var nameReader = HandXml.Default.Attribute("name")
    .First("member");
string name = nameReader.Get(xmlReader);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="22-读取强类型值">2.2 读取强类型值</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>使用Attribute泛型方法读取属性强类型值</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var text = @$"&lt;?xml version=""1.0"" encoding=""utf-8""?&gt;
    &lt;User Id=""123""&gt;Jxj&lt;/User&gt;";
using var stringReader = new StringReader(text);
using var xmlReader = XmlReader.Create(stringReader);
var idReader = HandXml.Default.Attribute&lt;int&gt;("Id")
    .First("User");
int result = idReader.Get(xmlReader);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="3-解析到实体">3. 解析到实体</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>xml反序列化</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="31-从子节点解析">3.1 从子节点解析</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>Entity泛型方法指定实体类型</li>
<li>WithItem方法读取子节点原始值并绑到实体</li>
<li>WithItem泛型方法读取子节点强类型值并绑到实体</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var text = @"&lt;?xml version=""1.0"" encoding=""utf-8""?&gt;
    &lt;User&gt;
	    &lt;Id&gt;123&lt;/Id&gt;
	    &lt;Name&gt;Jxj&lt;/Name&gt;
	    &lt;Age&gt;20&lt;/Age&gt;
    &lt;/User&gt;";
 using var stringReader = new StringReader(text);
 using var xmlReader = XmlReader.Create(stringReader);
 var userParser = HandXml.Default.Entity&lt;User&gt;()
     .WithItem&lt;int&gt;(nameof(User.Id))
     .WithItem(nameof(User.Name))
     .WithItem&lt;int&gt;(nameof(User.Age))
     .First();
 User result = userParser.Get(xmlReader);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="32-从属性解析">3.2 从属性解析</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>Entity泛型方法指定实体类型</li>
<li>WithAttribute方法读取属性原始值并绑到实体</li>
<li>WithAttribute泛型方法读取属性强类型值并绑到实体</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var text = @$"&lt;?xml version=""1.0"" encoding=""utf-8""?&gt;
    &lt;User Id=""123"" Name=""Jxj"" Age=""20"" /&gt;";
using var stringReader = new StringReader(text);
using var xmlReader = XmlReader.Create(stringReader);
var config = HandXml.Default;
var userParser = config.Entity&lt;User&gt;()
    .WithAttribute&lt;int&gt;(nameof(User.Id))
    .WithAttribute(nameof(User.Name))
    .WithAttribute&lt;int&gt;(nameof(User.Age))
    .First("User");
User result = userParser.Get(xmlReader);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="33-从本节点解析">3.3 从本节点解析</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>Entity可选参数contentName指定本节点原始值绑定实体的成员名</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var text = @$"&lt;?xml version=""1.0"" encoding=""utf-8""?&gt;
    &lt;User Id=""123"" Age=""age""&gt;Jxj&lt;/User&gt;";
using var stringReader = new StringReader(text);
using var xmlReader = XmlReader.Create(stringReader);
var config = HandXml.Default;
var userParser = config.Entity&lt;User&gt;(nameof(User.Name))
    .WithAttribute&lt;int&gt;(nameof(User.Id))
    .WithAttribute&lt;int&gt;(nameof(User.Age))
    .First("User");
User result = userParser.Get(xmlReader);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="4-解析集合">4. 解析集合</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>通过Repeat方法定义集合解析</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var text = @"&lt;?xml version=""1.0"" encoding=""utf-8""?&gt;
    &lt;Users&gt;
    &lt;User&gt;
        &lt;Id&gt;1&lt;/Id&gt;
        &lt;Name&gt;张三&lt;/Name&gt;
    &lt;/User&gt;
    &lt;User&gt;
        &lt;Id&gt;2&lt;/Id&gt;
        &lt;Name&gt;李四&lt;/Name&gt;
    &lt;/User&gt;
    &lt;User&gt;
        &lt;Id&gt;3&lt;/Id&gt;
        &lt;Name&gt;&lt;![CDATA[&lt;B&gt;王二&lt;/B&gt;]]&gt;&lt;/Name&gt;
    &lt;/User&gt;
    &lt;/Users&gt;";
using var stringReader = new StringReader(text);
using var xmlReader = XmlReader.Create(stringReader);
var config = HandXml.Default;
var repeatReader = config.Entity&lt;User&gt;()
    .WithItem&lt;int&gt;(nameof(User.Id))
    .WithItem(nameof(User.Name))
    .Repeat(nameof(User));
User[] result = repeatReader.Get(xmlReader)
    .ToArray();
</code></pre>
<h3 id="5-包装类型转化">5. 包装类型转化</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>Convert方法转入一个转化器可以变成另一个类型的解析器</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var text = @$"&lt;?xml version=""1.0"" encoding=""utf-8""?&gt;
    &lt;User Id=""123""&gt;Jxj&lt;/User&gt;";
using var stringReader = new StringReader(text);
using var xmlReader = XmlReader.Create(stringReader);
var idReader = HandXml.Default.Attribute&lt;long&gt;("Id")
    .Convert(id =&gt; new UserId(id))
    .First("User");
UserId result = idReader.Get(xmlReader);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="6-复杂类型">6. 复杂类型</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>通过WithItem可以把一个解析器绑定到主解析器的成员上</li>
<li>通过WithRepeate可以把集合解析器绑定到主解析器的成员上</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="61-复杂类型的case">6.1 复杂类型的Case</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">using var fs = new FileStream("rss.xml", FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read);
using var xmlReader = XmlReader.Create(fs);
var config = HandXml.Default;
var imageParser = config.Entity&lt;RssImage&gt;()
    .WithItem("url", nameof(RssImage.Url))
    .WithItem("name", nameof(RssImage.Name));
var itemParser = config.Entity&lt;RssItem&gt;()
    .WithItem("title", nameof(RssItem.Title))
    .WithItem("link", nameof(RssItem.Link))
    .Repeat("item");
var rssParser = config.Entity&lt;Rss&gt;()
    .WithItem&lt;string&gt;("title", nameof(Rss.Title))
    .WithItem(imageParser, "image", nameof(Rss.Image))
    .WithRepeat(itemParser, nameof(Rss.Items));
Rss rss = rssParser.Get(xmlReader);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="62-支持绑定子解析器的withitem重载方法">6.2 支持绑定子解析器的WithItem重载方法</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>item为子解析器</li>
<li>node为调用该解析器的子节点名</li>
<li>member为子解析器解析结果绑定实体成员名</li>
<li>TItem为子解析器解析结果和实体成员共同的类型</li>
<li>如果类型不一致结果会抛异常或被抛弃</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">EntityParser&lt;TEntity&gt; WithItem&lt;TItem&gt;(IXmlParser&lt;TItem&gt; item, string node, string member);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="63-withrepeat方法">6.3 WithRepeat方法</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>repeate为集合解析器</li>
<li>member为绑定实体成员名</li>
<li>类型为TItem[]</li>
<li>如果实体成员类型不是TItem[]不能用该方法,应该是WithItem结合Convert来使用</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">EntityParser&lt;TEntity&gt; WithRepeat&lt;TItem&gt;(RepeatReader&lt;TItem&gt; repeat, string member);
</code></pre>
<h2 id="三parsexml的模块化">三、ParseXml的模块化</h2>
<h3 id="1-handxml是parsexml的配置基座">1. HandXml是ParseXml的配置基座</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>HandXml包含Builders、Converters和DefaultValues</li>
<li>Builders、Converters和DefaultValues参与到解析Xml的各个过程内</li>
<li>通过Builders、Converters和DefaultValues配置可以调整Xml解析的结果和性能</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">class HandXml
{
    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 构造器提供者
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    IMemberBuilderProvider Builders { get; }
        /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 转化器
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    XmlConvertCacher Converters { get; }
        /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 默认值提供者
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    DefaultValueBuilder DefaultValues { get; }
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="11-builders负责对象构建">1.1 Builders负责对象构建</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>默认使用反射构建</li>
<li>支持配置</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 注册工厂
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    /// &lt;typeparam name="TProvider"&gt;&lt;/typeparam&gt;
    /// &lt;typeparam name="TEntity"&gt;&lt;/typeparam&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="provider"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="creator"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;
    /// &lt;returns&gt;&lt;/returns&gt;
    TProvider UseCreator&lt;TProvider, TEntity&gt;(this TProvider provider, ICreator&lt;IMemberBuilder&lt;TEntity&gt;&gt; creator);
        /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 注册工厂
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    /// &lt;typeparam name="TProvider"&gt;&lt;/typeparam&gt;
    /// &lt;typeparam name="TEntity"&gt;&lt;/typeparam&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="provider"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="func"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;
    /// &lt;returns&gt;&lt;/returns&gt;
    TProvider UseCreator&lt;TProvider, TEntity&gt;(this TProvider provider, Func&lt;IMemberBuilder&lt;TEntity&gt;&gt; func);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="12-converters负责xml节点原始处理">1.2 Converters负责xml节点原始处理</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>默认使用XmlConvert处理</li>
<li>默认支持18种基础类型(bool、byte、short、char、sbyte、ushort、int、uint、long、ulong、float、double、decimal、DateTime、string、Guid、DateTimeOffset和TimeSpan等)</li>
<li>支持配置</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 配置转化器
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
/// &lt;typeparam name="TValue"&gt;&lt;/typeparam&gt;
/// &lt;typeparam name="TConverter"&gt;&lt;/typeparam&gt;
/// &lt;param name="converter"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;
HandXml Use&lt;TValue, TConverter&gt;(TConverter converter);
/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 配置转化器
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
/// &lt;typeparam name="TValue"&gt;&lt;/typeparam&gt;
/// &lt;param name="converter"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;
HandXml Use&lt;TValue&gt;(Converter&lt;string, TValue&gt; converter);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="13-defaultvalues负责默认值">1.3 DefaultValues负责默认值</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>各类型的默认值默认是default</li>
<li>支持配置</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 设置默认值
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
/// &lt;typeparam name="TValue"&gt;&lt;/typeparam&gt;
/// &lt;param name="value"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;
/// &lt;returns&gt;&lt;/returns&gt;
DefaultValueBuilder Use&lt;TValue&gt;(TValue value);
</code></pre>
<h2 id="四parsexml的组件化">四、ParseXml的组件化</h2>
<h3 id="1-xml解析接口ixmlparser">1. Xml解析接口IXmlParser</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>对Xml单节点、属性、重复节点或者复杂节点的解析类都实现了IXmlParser</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// Xml解析接口
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
/// &lt;typeparam name="TResult"&gt;&lt;/typeparam&gt;
interface IXmlParser&lt;TResult&gt;
{
    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 解析
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="reader"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="result"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;
    /// &lt;returns&gt;&lt;/returns&gt;
    bool TryParser(XmlReader reader, out TResult result);
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-ixmlparser的主要实现类">2. IXmlParser的主要实现类</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>AttributeReader和ContentReader是基础实现</li>
<li>其他类都是通过组装IXmlParser实例来实现</li>
<li>通过完美的组件化可以模拟和解析复杂的Xml文件</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<p>| 类                              | 作用                                                                       |<br>
| ------- ------- ------- ------  | :------------------------------------------------------------------------- |<br>
| AttributeReader                 | 读取属性的原始文本                                                         |<br>
| ContentReader                   | 读取节点的原始文本                                                         |<br>
| PrimitiveReader                 | 调用AttributeReader或ContentReader,使用Converters把文本转化为需要的类型    |<br>
| ConvertParser&lt;TSource, TDest&gt; | 把一种类型的解析器封装为另一种类型的解析器                                 |<br>
| FirstReader&lt;TResult&gt;          | 解析碰到的第一个该节点                                                     |<br>
| RepeatReader&lt;TResult&gt;         | 解析连续重复的该节点                                                       |<br>
| EntityParser&lt;TEntity&gt;          | 解析包含多个属性或子节点为实体类型的成员                                   |</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">class PrimitiveReader&lt;TPrimitive&gt;(IXmlParser&lt;string&gt; original, IConverter&lt;string, TPrimitive&gt; converter, TPrimitive defaultValue);
class ConvertParser&lt;TSource, TDest&gt;(HandXml xml, IXmlParser&lt;TSource&gt; original, IConverter&lt;TSource, TDest&gt; converter, TDest defaultValue);
class FirstReader&lt;TResult&gt;(string element, IXmlParser&lt;TResult&gt; original, TResult defaultValue);
class RepeatReader&lt;TResult&gt;(HandXml xml, string name, IXmlParser&lt;TResult&gt; item);
class EntityParser&lt;TEntity&gt;(HandXml xml, ICreator&lt;IMemberBuilder&lt;TEntity&gt;&gt; creator, IMemberParser? content, bool hasItem = false);
</code></pre>
<h2 id="五parsexml的可扩展性">五、ParseXml的可扩展性</h2>
<h3 id="1-entityparsertentity的扩展性">1. EntityParser&lt;TEntity&gt;的扩展性</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>EntityParser可以用来处理复杂Xml和复杂类型</li>
<li>可扩展性在处理复杂问题时可简化配置或提供性能</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="2-userparser扩展entityparser的示例">2. UserParser扩展EntityParser的示例</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>UserParser封装了对象解析器,提高性能</li>
<li>UserParser封装了节点配置,简化使用</li>
<li>重写ReadAttributes跳过属性解析提高性能</li>
<li>重写ReadItem,使用switch代替字典查找提高性能</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">public class UserParser(HandXml xml)
    : EntityParser&lt;User&gt;(xml, UserBuilder2.Creater, null, true)
{
    #region 配置
    private readonly IXmlParser&lt;int&gt; _id = xml.Content&lt;int&gt;();
    private readonly ContentReader _name = xml.Content();
    private readonly IXmlParser&lt;int&gt; _age = xml.Content&lt;int&gt;();
    #endregion
    /// &lt;inheritdoc /&gt;
    public override void ReadAttributes(IMemberStore entity, XmlReader reader) { }
    /// &lt;inheritdoc /&gt;
    public override void ReadItem(IMemberBuilder&lt;User&gt; entity, XmlReader reader, string name)
    {
        if (entity is UserBuilder2 builder)
            ReadItem(builder.Original, reader, name);
        else
            base.ReadItem(entity, reader, name);
    }
    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 使用自定义构造器
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="entity"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="reader"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="name"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;
    public void ReadItem(User entity, XmlReader reader, string name)
    {        
        switch (name)
        {
            case nameof(User.Id):
                if (_id.TryParser(reader, out var idResult))
                    entity.Id = idResult;
                break;
            case nameof(User.Name):
                if (_name.TryParser(reader, out var nameResult))
                    entity.Name = nameResult;
                break;
            case nameof(User.Age):
                if (_age.TryParser(reader, out var ageResult))
                    entity.Age = ageResult;
                break;
        }
    }
}
</code></pre>
